pages.text: Monday. Walked to the market with Anna. Bought bread and apples. Felt calm after rain.
Tuesday. Sketched the riverbank. Ideas for a longer trip next month. Paris keeps coming up.
Wednesday. Quiet evening. Listed tasks: write letters, sort photos, call Bob.
